what: per city that was asked about: the median monthly search-referred readers of that city's Wikipedia article, per language that has one

title_half.source: Wikidata P1566 sitelinks and GeoNames alternateNamesV2 wkdt

count_half.note: the tables are a local capture reproducible from the dumps and are not tracked; see search-clicks.provenance.json

a_language_absent_from_clicks_means: that language edition has no article about this place, which is a measurement
a_zero_in_clicks_means: the article exists and had under ten search-referred clicks a month, the dump's own privacy floor. Also a measurement.
a_city_absent_from_this_file_means: no capture asked about it, so NOTHING is known and it must not be admitted, nor counted as a zero in any calibration
why: Read only to answer whether a CITY is sought by speakers of a language. It can never establish that a FAMILY intent exists in a market.
